payload.comment: Preprocessing stage is clean with no deterministic findings. All core integrity checks pass: archive MD5 (a8b06965200029087d5bd730944a56c1) verified, split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official PathMNIST, 28×28×3 RGB / 9-class schema confirmed, zero blank images, zero duplicates, and class proportions are near-identical between train and val (imbalance ratio 1.63). The representation plan is internally consistent: 6 built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) × 89996 + 89996 original = 629972 augmented train size, matching the split manifest. Normalization via z-score using train-split channel statistics is appropriate given the asymmetric H&E channel variance (G: σ=0.177 vs R/B: σ≈0.124). The two extension proposals (hflip_only_aug, compact_conv_token_transformer) are correctly in pending_review status; hflip is a built-in primitive and its use in the representation plan is valid regardless of the pending proposal. The compact_conv_token_transformer proposal will require hash-bound review before activation. Minor traceability and documentation items are noted below but none block progression.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Ollama) across ingestion, profiling, and prior-art artefacts; LLM-component traceability is incomplete. Recommend recording the model digest or a verifiable snapshot identifier in subsequent stages.

Test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center; this is a documented OOD characteristic of PathMNIST. Downstream evaluation reporting must explicitly flag this to avoid conflating in-distribution and cross-center performance.

Extension gate: both proposals (hflip_only_aug spec_sha256=3541e66a…, compact_conv_token_transformer spec_sha256=4004d69e…) remain pending_review with no reviewer assigned. The hflip primitive is already available as a built-in augmentation and does not require this approval; the compact_conv_token_transformer proposal must complete hash-bound review before any architecture change is applied.

Prior-art: ghostnet_vgg_robustness idea draws a class-imbalance generalization inference from quantization-robustness evidence; the logical bridge is weak. Correctly tagged hypothesis_to_validate, but the inference should not be treated as supported without additional evidence.

Prior-art: augmentation_model_quality idea cites arxiv_2508_18509v1 (a machine-unlearning paper) as primary evidence for a tissue-polarity augmentation-quality claim; the source is tangential to the specific inference. Verify or replace with a more directly relevant citation.

Data-profile ambiguity risks at 28×28 resolution (background/debris/mucus overlap, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, lymphocytes vs. debris) are well-documented but will constrain achievable accuracy; downstream evaluation should report per-class metrics to surface these confusions.
